title: DecisionReplay: A Corpus and Offline Simulator for Ensembling Decision Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.34627v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Comparing ensembles, routers and cascades requires the output of every model on every item, and its cost. Stored collections built for routing keep no per-option probabilities. We provide a dataset on which ensemble methods, routers and cascades are simulated quickly, without new model calls. DecisionReplay holds the probability vectors of 17 commercial decision models, endpoints that return a probability for every answer option, on 35 benchmarks, with the token counts, billed cost and measured latency of every call, all released. A deterministic simulator replays any policy that selects, combines or cascades them. One well-chosen model per benchmark is hard to beat: pooling all models loses 2.7 accuracy points to it, and stacking gains 1.0 points at 3.4 times its cost. translated_title: DecisionReplay：用于集成决策模型的语料库与离线模拟器
translated_abstract: 比较集成方法、路由器和级联需要获取每个模型在每个条目上的输出及其成本。为路由而构建的存储集合并不保留每个选项的概率。我们提供了一个数据集，可在其上快速模拟集成方法、路由器和级联，而无需新的模型调用。DecisionReplay 包含 17 个商业决策模型（即为每个答案选项返回概率的端点）在 35 个基准测试上的概率向量，以及每次调用的 token 数量、计费成本和实测延迟，并全部公开发布。一个确定性模拟器可以重放任何对这些模型进行选择、组合或级联的策略。在每个基准测试上，一个精心选择的单一模型很难被超越：汇总所有模型会损失 2.7 个准确率百分点，而堆叠方法以 3.4 倍的成本仅获得 1.0 个百分点的提升。这些模型会一起犯错：两个都出错的模型在 72% 的情况下会选择相同的错误选项。最佳路由器以该模型 64% 的成本达到同等性能，并可验证（摘要在此处被截断）……
tldr: DecisionReplay 发布了 17 个商业决策模型在 35 个基准测试上的完整概率向量及成本延迟数据，使集成、路由和级联策略可在离线确定性模拟器中快速评估；实验表明精心挑选的单一模型很难被超越，而最佳路由器能以其 64% 的成本达到同等性能。
en_tdlr: DecisionReplay releases the full probability vectors, costs, and latencies of 17 commercial decision models across 35 benchmarks, enabling fast offline evaluation of ensembling, routing, and cascading policies; it shows that a single well-chosen model is hard to beat, while the best router matches it at 64% of the cost.
